decision_conditions: The development to which this permission relates must be begun not later than the expiration of three years beginning with the date of the decision notice. Reason: To comply with the provisions of S.51 of the Planning & Compulsory Purchase Act 2004.

The development hereby permitted shall be carried out in accordance with the following approved plans:Location PlanB316734-01-3000 Rev AB316734-01-1100 Rev AB316734-01-3100 Rev AReason: For the avoidance of doubt and in the interests of proper planning.

All new external work shall be carried out in materials that match the existing building or as specified in the approved application.Reason: To safeguard the appearance of the premises and the character of the immediate area.

Prior to the installation of the air conditioning units, details of the make and model and an accompanying acoustic report shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority. The report should demonstrate a noise level of 37dBA or less at nearest openable windows of neighbouring properties. In addition, there must be no evidence of specific tonal elements in all frequencies. The development shall be implemented in accordance with the approved details.  Reason: To protect the local amenity from noise and disturbance.
description: Single storey wraparound extension to rear involving removal of existing rear conservatory and installation of 2x air conditioning units.
